questions.q: How many protons, neutrons and electrons are in the ion ³⁷₁₇Cl⁻?
questions.why: Protons = 17, neutrons = 37 − 17 = 20, and the 1− charge means one extra electron: 18.

questions.q: Ammonia and hydrogen chloride diffuse along a tube. Why does the white ring form nearer the hydrochloric acid end?
options: NH₃ has a lower Mr so diffuses faster
HCl has a lower Mr so diffuses faster
HCl is a liquid and NH₃ is a gas
questions.why: NH₃ (Mr 17) is lighter than HCl (Mr 36.5), so it diffuses faster and travels further.

questions.q: An atom has the electronic configuration 2,8,6. In which group and period is it?
questions.why: Outer-shell electrons (6) give the group; occupied shells (3) give the period.

questions.q: Explain, in terms of particles, why the temperature stays constant while a pure solid is melting.
questions.model: The energy supplied is used to overcome the forces of attraction between the particles, not to increase their kinetic energy.
points: energy used to overcome forces of attraction between particles
not used to increase kinetic energy / speed of particles
